angle: level, lens on the dry flagstones
start_frame: Straight across the hall from the south-east doors to the low curtain, lens on the stone: she sits up out of the lie-down, a wall of blue cotton and one knee filling the frame, her face high in it and only half in shot.
end_frame: The same frame as she hunches under the vault with her knees pulled to her chin and her face crumples — the dry stone still dry, no lamp fitting anywhere in frame.
constraint_honoured: 'From this frame to the end of the episode the camera stays below 1.0 m and NO lamp fixture appears in frame' — the height is set here at 0.35 m and never rises again.
movement_note: Giant-fragment grammar on the space lens; her bulk fills the upper frame, which is what keeps the 2.30 m lamp line out of shot without any cheating.
